verdict.rationale: Penpot ships an official MCP server explicitly designed so any AI agent/LLM can 'prompt away' to read and manipulate design files expressed as code, directly enabling natural-language operation, backed by plugin API and access tokens for automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the MCP server actually working end-to-end in practice (community comments only cover general UI/performance, not the AI/MCP workflow specifically).
